chunks: And in the narration of Samāʿah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
"The legal punishment of the adulterer is among the most severe that prescribed punishments can be."

key_terms.الزَّانِي: the one who commits adultery or fornication
key_terms.حَدُّ الزَّانِي: the prescribed legal punishment for the adulterer

ai.seo_question: How severe is the hadd punishment for adultery in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the hadd punishment for zina is of the most severe among the prescribed legal punishments. It highlights the grave legal status of adultery in Islamic jurisprudence and its place within the system of hudud.
